products.name: Truyo
products.note: AI governance platform grown out of consent and privacy automation; automated AI inventory, risk assessment, and compliance workflows; recognized in Gartner's 2026 AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant

profile_text.body:
Truyo is a software company whose platform is designed to help organizations manage AI governance, privacy compliance, consent and preference management, and third-party risk assessment. The company describes its offering as an all-in-one solution for identifying and tracking AI usage across departments, resolving AI risks, and achieving compliance with data privacy and AI regulations worldwide. Core capabilities include scanning websites, source code, and content for AI footprints, testing AI models for bias, discrimination, and hallucinations, automating data subject access requests, and conducting vendor assessments to evaluate third-party AI and privacy compliance. The platform also includes a learning management system for training employees and AI Governance Board members, as well as pre-built connectors called Truyo QuikLinks for integrating with existing technology stacks.

The company's held facts indicate that the Truyo platform grew out of consent and privacy automation and has expanded into automated AI inventory, risk assessment, and compliance workflows. The platform is recognized in Gartner's 2026 AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant and was named a 2023 Innovation Award Finalist by the IAPP. Forrester has also recognized the platform for its capabilities in delivering tailored solutions to large enterprises. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records appear in the available data.
